entities.name: Query protein 493 aa
observations: Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q9HLX6 from Thermoplasma acidophilum.
Annotated as a putative Lon protease homolog with ATP-binding function; EC 3.4.21.- is provisional.
Sequence length is 493 aa; calculated molecular mass is 55.5 kDa and theoretical pI is 5.77.
Sequence contains a Walker A/P-loop-like ATPase motif around residues 40-50: LLLVGPPGVGKSM.
Local Pfam scanning detected Mg_chelatase-like, AAA_5, and Sigma54 activator-like profiles; these domain hits are potentially misleading and should be interpreted alongside exact homology.

entities.name: Q9HLX6
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Thermoplasma acidophilum; exact 100% identity and full-length coverage to the query.
Annotated as a putative Lon protease homolog; ATP binding GO:0005524 and regulation of DNA-templated transcription GO:0006355 are recorded.
UniProt records EC 3.4.21.-, indicating a putative ATP-dependent proteolytic enzyme but not a fully specified catalytic classification.

entities.name: Archaeal proteostasis
observations: The likely biological role is ATP-dependent quality-control proteolysis of damaged, misfolded, or regulatory proteins, inferred from Lon-protease homology; a specific pathway assignment was not retrieved.
